dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Lucrative Offer: Seeking a guide intimately familiar with all of Nod-Krai. We only have one non-negotiable requirement: Beauty. My master simply cannot abide an... aesthetically challenged escort anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Sounds like you're looking for me! Nobody can name a better guide than I, Ratimir, 'round these parts! You'll find me charming clients at the harbor on the daily. Come find me if you're interested in the real deal!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "You do not meet our requirements. Thank you."
